title: Sling migration implementation workshare
proposition: A customer-owned migration workspace that retains the original configuration, runs the original Sling engine, compares every selected business row, and carries the reviewed cutover into a complete receiving handoff.

commercial.clockStart: The engagement starts when the scope is accepted, the first milestone is paid, and the agreed configuration, source/target access and named reviewer are available.

scope.connectorSelection: One agreed source/target database connector pair supported by the selected Sling release; the customer-specific complete typed-export adapter is included in the paid implementation.
scope.referenceAdapter: The included runnable reference uses the original CSV sources and distinct SQLite source/parallel databases. Other connector execution adapters are an engagement deliverable.
excluded: Airbyte CDC/history reconstruction or SCD2 emulation
Undeclared custom transformation rewrites or unsupported connector development
Production scheduling, ongoing hosting, warehouse consumption and third-party subscription fees
Destructive replacement of an existing production dataset

phases.title: Configuration and migration contract
phases.deliverable: Retain the original configuration and source metadata; select tables, namespaces, keys, cursor and explicit type mappings; agree the parallel destination and acceptance.

phases.title: Native baseline and connector adaptation
phases.deliverable: Configure the original Sling binary on the customer-owned host, implement the selected typed export adapter, execute the complete baseline and retain all native outputs.

phases.title: Change edition and full comparison
phases.deliverable: Apply the agreed incremental/source-schema change and compare every selected business cell, duplicate multiplicity, key and type; document every unresolved difference.

phases.title: Consumer switch and rollback
phases.deliverable: Switch one agreed consumer to the accepted parallel edition, observe its actual results, restore the retained prior selection, then adopt the reviewed final selection.

phases.title: Receiving and operating handoff
phases.deliverable: Transfer editable source, configuration, native outputs, decisions and full history; reopen the same named packages on a fresh private workspace and complete one consolidated correction cycle.

acceptance: The selected original configuration and executable/archive identities are retained with the agreed connector bindings.
Both baseline and incremental comparisons cover all selected rows and cells, including multiplicity; schema and primary-key checks pass and the original native commands exit successfully.
The selected plan and comparison identities match the cutover; the actual consumer reads the accepted edition and rollback restores the recorded prior edition.
The receiving workspace preserves source bytes, native attempts, decisions, complete history and the named handoff bytes; the customer can operate and edit the delivered application.

responsibilities.tjlabs: Own implementation, selected connector/export adaptation, original native execution and recovery, full comparison, consumer transition, operating guide and complete receiving package.
responsibilities.partner: Provide the chosen connection/configuration, permitted source and parallel target access, an owned execution host, representative change input, the consumer owner and one consolidated review.
responsibilities.costs: The proposed fee covers implementation effort. Customer-owned compute, storage, network and database/warehouse consumption remain customer operating costs; no hosted service subscription is included.

reference.meaning: Counts describe the complete selected original reference and its derived expectation. Actual run completion is stated only when the accompanying customer result is present.

sources.claim: SlingData publishes a migration path from Airbyte that includes destination review and downstream transition.
Sling provides the native replication engine used by this workshare.
Official installation and connection documentation define the native operating entry points.
The official company contact form accepts a full name, email and inquiry message.
